in_marathi.name: Biaka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Biaka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Biaka is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Beeja', meaning 'seed'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the sound made by bees, which is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune. The name Biaka is also believed to signify the beginning of something new and auspicious.
